title: This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. (CVE-2026-58944)
description: CVE-2026-58944 is a vulnerability in the moveTaskToFrontLocked function of ActivityTaskManagerService.java that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges without needing additional execution rights or user interaction. The issue arises from a confused deputy problem leading to a background application launch. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.4 and impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
